patches.name: 0001-use-explicit-acquisition-and-preserved-sysroot.patch
patches.purpose: Honor explicit flags selecting the recorded Git acquisition adapter and independently prepared sysroot. Preserve upstream initialization, metadata, patch and product targets.

patches.name: 0002-select-coreclr-native-arm64-tools.patch
patches.purpose: Select Clang 6 and omit redundant cross-architecture host tools only for the explicit native Linux ARM64 build; retain the existing cross/sysroot switches.

patches.name: 0003-forward-corefx-native-arm64-sysroot.patch
patches.purpose: Use the existing BuildNativeCompiler pass-through to select Clang 6 and cross mode for the independently prepared target sysroot.

patches.name: 0004-preserve-core-setup-native-arm64-crossgen.patch
patches.purpose: Keep actual native image generation enabled for same-architecture ARM64 hosts while retaining Core-Setup cross/sysroot compilation.

patches.name: 0005-use-actual-aspnetcore-installer-rid.patch
patches.purpose: Use the selected Linux target RID for the locally built ASP.NET Core archive instead of always requesting x64.

patches.name: 0006-run-native-arm64-corelib-crossgen.patch
patches.purpose: Run the locally built native ARM64 crossgen instead of copying IL CoreLib during same-architecture sysroot builds. Package the actual native tool layout without redundant cross-host folders.

patches.name: 0007-select-clang6-corehost-native-arm64-cross-build.patch
patches.purpose: Select the installed Clang 6 pair explicitly for native ARM64 Core-Setup sysroot builds, preserving the historical compiler selection for other host-target pairs.

patches.name: 0008-route-upstream-smoke-tests-to-built-arm64-sdk.patch
patches.purpose: Accept the explicit core-sdk graph, select its ARM64 local package directory and allow a new isolated test working directory. Preserve all upstream test commands and assertions; this routing change alone establishes no test result.

patches.name: 0009-map-retired-package-indexes-in-configs-and-environment.patch
patches.purpose: Add a build-tool task mapping only five exact retired package indexes to the official dotnet-public NuGet index in configs and component environment strings; preserve requested package versions and local feeds.

patches.name: 0010-route-component-restore-through-recorded-feed-mapping.patch
patches.purpose: Apply the recorded exact endpoint mapping through the existing common config/RepoBuild producer before online component restores; retain upstream source-built feed injection and offline behavior.

patches.name: 0011-preserve-explicit-complete-darc-command.patch
patches.purpose: Preserve the explicit complete source-acquisition command at the older FetchSources producer. The fixed wrapper binds every required Git adapter argument, including bin/src, because this generation does not append DarcCloneArguments to an explicit command.

patches.name: 0012-pin-bootstrap-arcade-restore-to-local-and-official-feeds.patch
patches.purpose: For projects using the retained bootstrap Arcade only, set the supported global RestoreSources to the local source-built package directory. Supported RestoreAdditionalProjectSources supplies recorded official NuGet/Microsoft indexes, preventing the old SDK from appending retired MyGet endpoints while preserving exact versions, TLS verification and offline behavior.

patches.name: 0013-build-local-coreclr-packages-on-native-arm64.patch
patches.purpose: Omit only the historical skipnuget switch for explicit native Linux ARM64 builds, so the original CoreCLR packaging target emits the local runtime transport packages required by CoreSetup. Preserve cross/sysroot/native image generation and all other ARM host-target behavior.

patches.name: 0014-preserve-sourcelink-bootstrap-version-until-common-is-built.patch
patches.purpose: Preserve the pinned SourceLink bootstrap dependency while its own Common package version is unavailable. Emit the deferred flow override only when a real Common version exists, retaining original overwrite protection and later local-source propagation. No package version is substituted.

patches.name: 0015-honor-explicit-cli-http-handler-selection.patch
patches.purpose: Honor an explicit supported HTTP handler selection in the historical CLI restore driver; preserve its original Curl default when unset. The native harness selects SocketsHttpHandler with normal TLS verification.

patches.name: 0016-backport-gdbjit-array-base-size-query.patch
patches.purpose: Backport the upstream MethodTable base-size query for GDBJIT ARRAY/SZARRAY descriptions. The old EEClass::GetSize API is FEATURE_PREJIT-only and fails this supported native configuration; preserve GDBJIT rather than disabling the feature.

patches.name: 0017-forward-corefx-cross-mode-with-singleword-properties.patch
patches.purpose: Use independent singleword compiler and cross-build properties. The historical shell driver reparses quoted whitespace, so the original compiler property could split into multiple MSBuild arguments.

patches.name: 0018-forward-corefx-native-cross-build-property.patch
patches.purpose: Forward the explicit CrossBuild property to the existing build-native.sh cross switch, independently of compiler selection. Unset and false keep the original native default; true uses the authenticated target sysroot.

patches.name: 0020-map-retired-coreclr-package-index.patch
patches.purpose: Map the exact retired dotnet-coreclr package service index used by the pinned CoreCLR NuGet configuration to the official retained public feed. Preserve component package references, exact versions, native NuGet generation, TLS validation and all non-index asset URLs.

patches.name: 0021-select-explicit-retained-coreclr-platforms-tooling.patch
patches.purpose: Select an explicit retained bootstrap Platforms dependency only for native Linux ARM64 CoreCLR. The same genuine version controls the engineering tool reference and packaging runtime.json RID graph. Preserve the original unavailable RC2 source declaration, all native/crossgen/package targets and SDK/runtime product versions.

patches.name: 0022-build-pinned-arcade-genapi-for-corefx.patch
patches.purpose: Build and pack only the pinned Arcade GenAPI project and its normal project references through the supported ExcludeFromSourceBuild override. Preserve original source and target frameworks. Publish its real locally generated package/version through normal Arcade package collection; record Major runtime roll-forward for the netcoreapp2.1 tool on the bootstrap3.0 host. No test/API generation is skipped and no external package is relabeled.

patches.name: 0023-use-explicit-net472-reference-metadata-for-genapi.patch
patches.purpose: Supply the fixed official net472 reference-only input through its original scoped resolution targets for the extra GenAPI command. Preserve both original net472/netcoreapp2.1 targets, all source/dependency versions and the ordinary source-built package publisher. This is an explicit prebuilt compilation input, not a product reference override or executable Windows runtime.

patches.name: 0024-preserve-original-genapi-host-policy-and-validate-tool.patch
patches.purpose: Remove the added modern RollForward property, preserving only the original GenAPI rollForwardOnNoCandidateFx=2 template. Host3.0 rejects both policies together. Require native help and real bounded API-source generation from the newly built tool before normal package publication/CoreFX use; do not rewrite runtimeconfig/package bytes or bypass source generation.

patches.name: 0025-rebuild-explicit-genapi-project-runtime-output.patch
patches.purpose: Use the original supported rebuild operation only for the explicit GenAPI project and its normal project references. This regenerates stale SDK3.0 runtime configuration after removing the added policy, while preserving native/object caches, all original target frameworks, normal package/cache handling and the strict actual tool guard. No output file is manually rewritten.

patches.name: 0026-select-native-arm64-core-setup-crossgen-and-jit.patch
patches.purpose: Use the locally built native ARM64 crossgen and JIT when CoreSetup targets ARM64 on an existing Linux ARM64 host RID. Preserve x64-to-ARM64, ARM32 and all other original selectors; keep CrossGen, versions generation, runtime/ref packages and symbols enabled. Missing versions files after the original crossgen-path error are generated by their normal dependency target.

patches.name: 0027-accept-core-setup-default-unix-native-host-group.patch
patches.purpose: Recognize the pinned CoreSetup Linux default OSGroup=Unix as well as explicit Linux when selecting native ARM64 crossgen/JIT. Its Directory.Build.props maps MSBuild OS=Unix directly to OSGroup and already accepts either label for portable Linux RIDs. Preserve host RID architecture guard, all other host/target selectors and every original packaging/generation target.

patches.name: 0028-select-native-arm64-aspnet-crossgen-property.patch
patches.purpose: Pass the original CrossgenToolPackagePath property globally only for the verified native Linux ARM64 ASP build. Select the genuine locally built runtime package tools/crossgen without editing the upstream-patched ASP project, suppressing crossgen, changing source/package identity or replacing ready-to-run/perfmap commands. Other host/architecture arguments remain unchanged.

patches.name: 0029-select-native-arm64-core-sdk-crossgen-and-jit-properties.patch
patches.purpose: Forward explicit Architecture=arm64 and a bounded native-host selector flag only for the verified Linux ARM64 host/target. Original CoreSDK defaults architecture to x64 independently of Rid. Target-time assignments overwrite ordinary CrossgenPath/LibCLRJitRid globals, so preserve their normal formulas and use the companion guarded source selector. Keep all R2R targets and source/package versions.

patches.name: 0030-select-native-arm64-core-sdk-crossgen-and-jit-in-target.patch
patches.purpose: Select native tool and JIT inside the original CrossgenLayout target only when the explicit verified-host flag, ARM64 architecture and Linux OS all match. Preserve dynamic runtime-package/version formulas, package restore and the three original R2R/symbol task groups. Other host/architecture selectors remain unchanged; no executable or generated output is replaced.

patches.name: 0031-map-toolset-sdk-retired-package-indexes.patch
patches.purpose: Map the three exact retired VSTest, MSBuild and container-tools service indexes observed in the real Toolset nested SDK restore to the existing official retained public feed. Preserve explicit Docker SDK version 1.1.0, all other package versions, original restore/copy targets, TLS validation, local feed order, item metadata and every non-index asset URL.

patches.name: 0032-flow-native-arm64-aspnet-version-to-core-sdk.patch
patches.purpose: Flow the genuine Linux ARM64 ASP runtime package version into the original generic CoreSDK archive-version alias only for the verified native Linux ARM64 build. Update both existing alias items after the original root import, retaining their DoNotOverwrite metadata, deferred producer-key evaluation, all other host branches, original archive formulas and every source/package version. The old aliases reference absent LinuxX64/OsxX64 packages in this ARM64 construction.

patches.name: 0033-make-post-build-offline-bundle-downloads-explicit.patch
patches.purpose: Retain default online post-build downloads for the optional upstream offline source bundle, while allowing an explicit fresh CI SDK-only opt-out for its two retired staging archives. These targets run only after Build; their only unpacking consumer is OfflineBuild=true. Preserve online product restores, the complete root component graph, all package/test guards and ReportPrebuiltUsage. The CI source distribution captures actual build sources separately; it is not an upstream offline/Stage2 bootstrap bundle.

patches.name: 0034-map-retired-sdk-nugetclient-package-index.patch
patches.purpose: Map only the exact retired nuget-nugetclient service index observed in the pinned SDK component restore to the existing official retained public feed. Preserve all requested NuGet/package versions, normal restore ordering, local sources, TLS validation, asset URLs and every product/test target.
